overview: The Umbral Plains is the most dangerous planar frontier on Luclin, shaped by void resonance, shadow bleed-through, and Akhevan dominion. It serves as the planar counterweight to Maiden’s Eye and the Tenebrous Mountains.
history: The Plains formed when a planar fracture opened centuries ago, allowing void resonance to seep into Luclin.
Akhevan Dominion forces established ritual pylons to harness the planar bleed-through.
Umbral Vanguard was created specifically to contain the Plains and prevent planar collapse.
Shadow anomalies began manifesting, creating unpredictable zones of fear, distortion, and temporal instability.
Voidborn entities emerged from deep resonance pockets, threatening both Akheva and Vanguard forces.
regionHooks: A planar fracture expands, threatening to destabilize the entire Plains.
Akhevan Dominion ritualists attempt a void ascension.
Umbral Vanguard fortifications begin failing under storm pressure.
Shadow anomalies merge, creating a new mega-anomaly.
Voidborn entities swarm from a newly opened resonance basin.
